lines.zh: 我一跳一跳地走，菌盖晃得厉害。
lines.en: I go in hops and my cap wobbles badly.

lines.zh: 我的脚陷进湿土，拔出来带一声闷响。
lines.en: My feet sink into wet soil and come out with a thud.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，留下白色的菌丝。
lines.en: White mycelium is left wherever I walk.

lines.zh: 我拖着身子挪，菌褶里漏出孢子。
lines.en: I haul myself along and spores sift from my gills.

lines.zh: 我走两步就跺一下，像在试地面。
lines.en: Every two steps I stomp, as if testing the ground.

lines.zh: 我绕过石头，菌盖擦过树皮。
lines.en: I go around a rock and my cap scrapes the bark.

lines.zh: 我的步子很沉，落叶被踩成泥。
lines.en: My steps are heavy and fallen leaves turn to mud.

lines.zh: 我朝着阴影走，那里更潮。
lines.en: I walk toward the shade, where it is damper.

lines.zh: 我边走边发出低低的咕声。
lines.en: I let out a low croak as I walk.

lines.zh: 我停下来，用喙啄了啄树根。
lines.en: I stop and peck at a tree root.

lines.zh: 我一步一步挪向树林深处。
lines.en: I work my way deeper into the woods.

lines.zh: 我的菌柄弯了一下，又弹直。
lines.en: My stem bends once and springs straight again.

lines.zh: 我站着，菌盖慢慢起伏，像在呼吸。
lines.en: I stand still and my cap rises and falls like breathing.

lines.zh: 我把喙收进菌褶里，一动不动。
lines.en: I tuck my beak into my gills and do not move.

lines.zh: 孢子从我身下飘起来，又落下。
lines.en: Spores drift up from beneath me and settle again.

lines.zh: 我发出一声短叫，没人应。
lines.en: I give one short cry and nothing answers.

lines.zh: 我跺了跺地，听下面的回声。
lines.en: I stomp and listen to the echo below.

lines.zh: 我的菌盖转了半圈，朝着光。
lines.en: My cap turns half around toward the light.

lines.zh: 我吸了一口潮气，菌柄鼓起来。
lines.en: I draw in damp air and my stem swells.

lines.zh: 我盯着自己的影子，看了很久。
lines.en: I stare at my own shadow for a long while.

lines.zh: 我在树根边蹲下，装成一朵蘑菇。
lines.en: I crouch by a root and pass for an ordinary mushroom.

lines.zh: 我轻轻啄自己的菌柄，试它的硬度。
lines.en: I peck my own stem to test how hard it is.

lines.zh: 我忽然尖叫一声，然后安静了。
lines.en: I scream once, then go quiet.

lines.zh: 我的孢子落在苔上，白了一层。
lines.en: My spores settle on the moss and whiten it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢变换形态，又变回来。
lines.en: I shift my shape slowly, then shift back.

lines.zh: 有虫钻进我的菌褶，我懒得动。
lines.en: A bug crawls into my gills and I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我把菌盖歪向一边，听风。
lines.en: I tilt my cap to one side and listen to the wind.

lines.zh: 我在等孢子落满我的肩。
lines.en: I wait for spores to settle on my shoulders.

lines.zh: 我缩了缩菌柄，像打了个盹。
lines.en: I shrink my stem a little, like dozing off.

lines.zh: 我用喙梳理菌褶里的土。
lines.en: I comb the dirt out of my gills with my beak.

lines.zh: 我抬起菌盖，用看不见的眼睛看你。
lines.en: I lift my cap and look at you with eyes you cannot see.

lines.zh: 我把头歪向一边，孢子洒下来。
lines.en: I tilt my head and spores spill down.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，菌褶一开一合。
lines.en: I stare at you while my gills open and close.

lines.zh: 你靠近，我的菌柄绷紧了。
lines.en: You come near and my stem draws taut.

lines.zh: 我在你脚边站住，先闻你的味道。
lines.en: I stop by your feet and smell you first.

lines.zh: 我的喙微微张开，露出里面的纤维。
lines.en: My beak parts a little, showing the fibers inside.

lines.zh: 你说话时，我的菌盖抖了一下。
lines.en: When you speak my cap twitches once.

lines.zh: 我绕着你走了半圈，又停住。
lines.en: I walk half around you and stop.

lines.zh: 我看你手里的火把，光很刺眼。
lines.en: I look at your torch; the light stings.

lines.zh: 你举起武器，我也没退。
lines.en: You raise your weapon and I do not back away.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，准备跳。
lines.en: I lower my body, ready to leap.

lines.zh: 我一直在看你，直到你移开眼。
lines.en: I keep watching until you look away.

lines.zh: 我尖叫起来，声音撕得很长。
lines.en: I scream, and the sound tears on and on.

lines.zh: 你的剑削掉我半个菌盖，孢子喷出。
lines.en: Your sword shears off half my cap and spores burst out.

lines.zh: 疼得我跺了一下地，土都跳了。
lines.en: The pain makes me stomp and the soil jumps.

lines.zh: 我的喙被打偏，撞在自己身上。
lines.en: My beak is knocked aside and strikes my own body.

lines.zh: 我退到树后，菌褶全合上了。
lines.en: I retreat behind a tree and my gills clamp shut.

lines.zh: 这一下让我变了个形态，又变回来。
lines.en: The blow forces a new shape on me, then the old one returns.

lines.zh: 我被打得矮了一截，又慢慢长起。
lines.en: I am beaten a hand shorter, then slowly grow back.

lines.zh: 我的菌柄裂开，白浆渗出来。
lines.en: My stem splits and white sap seeps out.

lines.zh: 我嘶了一声，孢子从伤口往外冒。
lines.en: I hiss and spores pour from the wound.

lines.zh: 我倒下，土里那个我还等着再死一次。
lines.en: I fall, and the one in the soil waits to die again.

lines.zh: 你手里那块腐木，比什么都香。
lines.en: That rotting wood in your hand smells better than anything.

lines.zh: 我闻到湿泥和朽木，就挪不动了。
lines.en: I smell wet soil and rotten wood and cannot move on.

lines.zh: 你把蘑菇递过来，我的喙已经张开。
lines.en: You hold out a mushroom and my beak is already open.

lines.zh: 烂叶堆的味道，让我跳了过去。
lines.en: The reek of rotting leaves pulls me over in one hop.

lines.zh: 我追着那股霉味，忘了看路。
lines.en: I chase that musty smell and forget to watch the path.

lines.zh: 你手里的真菌肉，我认得。
lines.en: The fungal flesh in your hand is something I know.

lines.zh: 潮湿的土一翻，我就凑上去。
lines.en: Turn over damp earth and I come right up to it.

lines.zh: 我对亮晶晶的东西没兴趣，只爱腐木。
lines.en: Shiny things mean nothing to me; I love rotten wood.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，我立刻盖上菌盖护住。
lines.en: You set it down and I clamp my cap over it at once.

lines.zh: 香气一散，我就退回暗处。
lines.en: When the scent fades I retreat into the dark.

lines.zh: 撞上我像撞一棵小树，硬邦邦的。
lines.en: Hitting me is like hitting a small tree, stiff and solid.

lines.zh: 我的菌盖顶到你的腰，把你推开半步。
lines.en: My cap butts your waist and pushes you back half a pace.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的菌柄，我尖叫了一声。
lines.en: You step on my stem and I scream.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，孢子扑了你一脸。
lines.en: We crash together and spores burst across your face.

lines.zh: 我不躲，直接用身体挡住你的路。
lines.en: I do not dodge; I simply block your way with my body.

lines.zh: 我的菌盖很滑，你的手一按就滑开。
lines.en: My cap is slick and your hand slides right off.

lines.zh: 你撞歪了我的菌盖，它慢慢转回来。
lines.en: You knock my cap crooked and it slowly turns back.

lines.zh: 我的脚钉在土里，撞也撞不动。
lines.en: My feet are planted in the soil and cannot be shifted.

lines.zh: 我从你腿上弹开，落回原处。
lines.en: I bounce off your leg and land back where I stood.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我跟着顶上去。
lines.en: You take one step back and I press forward.

lines.zh: 我们的菌丝在土下连在一起。
lines.en: Our mycelium joins together under the soil.

lines.zh: 两只猛菇并排站着，孢子混成一片。
lines.en: Two Mightshrooms stand side by side, spores mingling.

lines.zh: 它跳一下，我也跳一下，地都震了。
lines.en: It hops, I hop, and the ground shakes.

lines.zh: 我们把菌盖贴在一起，声音很闷。
lines.en: We press our caps together and the sound is muffled.

lines.zh: 它尖叫，我回了一声，调子一样。
lines.en: It screams, I answer, and the pitch matches.

lines.zh: 我们撑开菌盖，把雨挡在外面。
lines.en: We spread our caps and hold the rain off.

lines.zh: 它在我的菌褶里放下孢子。
lines.en: It leaves its spores among my gills.

lines.zh: 我们一起变换形态，像两面镜子。
lines.en: We change shape together, like two mirrors.

lines.zh: 我们在树根边守着一块腐木。
lines.en: We guard one piece of rotten wood by a root.

lines.zh: 它走后，地上留下两圈白痕。
lines.en: After it goes, two white rings remain on the ground.

lines.zh: 我用喙叼起一块骨头，拖着走。
lines.en: I pick up a bone in my beak and drag it along.

lines.zh: 我没有手，菌盖只能用来挡雨。
lines.en: I have no hands; my cap is only good for the rain.

lines.zh: 那根远古骨，我衔了一下就掉了。
lines.en: I lift the ancient bone once and drop it.

lines.zh: 我把真菌肉压进菌褶里带走。
lines.en: I press fungal flesh into my gills and carry it off.

lines.zh: 我用脚把东西踢进土坑，再盖上叶。
lines.en: I kick things into a pit and cover them with leaves.

lines.zh: 我试着抱起它，只抱了一手孢子。
lines.en: I try to gather it up and come away with spores.

lines.zh: 东西太滑，我啄了三次才咬住。
lines.en: It is too slick; I peck three times before it holds.

lines.zh: 我把一朵灰菇顶在菌盖上带走。
lines.en: I balance a grey mushroom on my cap and carry it off.

lines.zh: 地上的碎骨，我一根根堆到树根。
lines.en: I pile the broken bones at the tree root one by one.

lines.zh: 你丢下的东西，我要先踩一脚。
lines.en: Whatever you drop, I stomp on it first.

lines.zh: 你踏进我的林地，我的喙张开了。
lines.en: You step into my woods and my beak opens.

lines.zh: 我锁住你的脚，那是最好啄的地方。
lines.en: I lock onto your feet, the best place to peck.

lines.zh: 你把火把举高，我反而更靠近。
lines.en: You raise your torch and I come closer instead.

lines.zh: 有东西碰了我的菌丝，我立刻知道了。
lines.en: Something touches my mycelium and I know at once.

lines.zh: 我尖叫一声，然后把你当成目标。
lines.en: I scream once and then count you as my target.

lines.zh: 你举剑的姿势，让我兴奋起来。
lines.en: The way you raise that sword excites me.

lines.zh: 我在三棵树外就盯上了你。
lines.en: I had you in sight three trees away.

lines.zh: 你踩断枯枝，我朝声音转过去。
lines.en: You snap a dead branch and I turn toward the sound.

lines.zh: 我的菌盖鼓起来，孢子准备喷出。
lines.en: My cap swells and the spores get ready to burst.

lines.zh: 目标不动，我也不动，比谁先眨眼。
lines.en: The target holds still and so do I, waiting the other out.

lines.zh: 我一跳一跳地跟着你，地都在响。
lines.en: I follow you in hops and the ground rings with it.

lines.zh: 你躲到树后，我绕过去等。
lines.en: You hide behind a tree and I go around to wait.

lines.zh: 我把身体压得很低，菌盖贴地。
lines.en: I press myself low with my cap against the ground.

lines.zh: 每跟一步，我的喙就张得更开。
lines.en: With each step I take, my beak opens wider.

lines.zh: 我不叫，孢子却一路飘着。
lines.en: I make no sound, but spores trail behind me.

lines.zh: 我堵在你退路上，慢慢站直。
lines.en: I block your retreat and straighten up slowly.

lines.zh: 你退，我进，始终隔着五步。
lines.en: You retreat, I advance, always five paces apart.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的膝盖，那里跳得最高。
lines.en: I watch your knees, which leap the highest.

lines.zh: 我用跺地声数你的脚步。
lines.en: I count your footsteps with my stomps.

lines.zh: 你停下了，我也停在你的影子里。
lines.en: You stop, and I stop inside your shadow.

lines.zh: 我扑上去啄你的膝盖，皮破了。
lines.en: I lunge and peck your knee until the skin breaks.

lines.zh: 我跺地，冲击把你震得往前一栽。
lines.en: I stomp and the shock pitches you forward.

lines.zh: 我的喙啄穿你的袖子，勾住线。
lines.en: My beak punches through your sleeve and hooks the thread.

lines.zh: 我用菌盖顶你，把你撞在树上。
lines.en: I ram you with my cap and pin you to a tree.

lines.zh: 我跳起来落在你背上，尖声大叫。
lines.en: I leap onto your back and scream at the top of my voice.

lines.zh: 这一啄被你挡开，我的喙麻了。
lines.en: You deflect the peck and my beak goes numb.

lines.zh: 我连啄三下，第二下最重。
lines.en: I peck three times, and the second lands hardest.

lines.zh: 我张嘴喷出孢子，趁你咳时啄你。
lines.en: I spit spores in your face and peck while you cough.

lines.zh: 我打完就跳开，站在腐木上。
lines.en: When it is over I hop back onto the rotten wood.

lines.zh: 我的爪子抓过你的小腿，留下一道白痕。
lines.en: My claws rake your calf and leave a white line.

lines.zh: 我从腐木里钻出来，菌盖还湿着。
lines.en: I push out of rotten wood with my cap still wet.

lines.zh: 第一件事是跺地，听这地方有多硬。
lines.en: The first thing I do is stomp and test the ground.

lines.zh: 我在夜里张开菌盖，孢子落了一地。
lines.en: I open my cap at night and spores fall everywhere.

lines.zh: 我从一堆烂叶里站起来，身上沾泥。
lines.en: I rise from a heap of rotting leaves, smeared with mud.

lines.zh: 我的第一声叫，把林子里的鸟惊飞了。
lines.en: My first cry sends the woodland birds flying.

lines.zh: 我落地时沉，土被压出一个坑。
lines.en: I land heavily and press a pit into the soil.

lines.zh: 四周的蘑菇丛里，我长得最高。
lines.en: Among the mushrooms around me, I stand tallest.

lines.zh: 我出生就会跳，虽然跳得歪。
lines.en: I can hop from birth, though I hop crooked.

lines.zh: 我摸着树根，记住这片林子的味道。
lines.en: I feel the roots and learn the smell of these woods.

lines.zh: 我从孢子团里成形，先长出喙。
lines.en: I take shape from a spore cloud, beak first.

lines.zh: 潮气很重，我很满意这地方。
lines.en: The damp is heavy here, and I am well pleased with it.

lines.zh: 我一出生就啄了自己的菌柄。
lines.en: I peck my own stem the moment I am born.

lines.zh: 火一烧，我的菌盖卷起来，气味像烤肉。
lines.en: Fire curls my cap and the smell is like roasting meat.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，菌盖裂成两半。
lines.en: I fall from a height and my cap splits in two.

lines.zh: 水灌进菌褶，我的孢子全漂走了。
lines.en: Water floods my gills and all my spores float away.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀散，孢子飘了满天。
lines.en: The blast scatters me and spores fill the sky.

lines.zh: 箭钉进菌盖，我带着它跳。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my cap and I hop on with it.

lines.zh: 药水渗进菌丝，我的颜色发暗。
lines.en: Potion soaks into my mycelium and my color dulls.

lines.zh: 土干了太久，我的菌盖缩了。
lines.en: The soil has been dry too long and my cap shrinks.

lines.zh: 雷劈在树上，我浑身菌丝都焦了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the tree and every thread of me is scorched.

lines.zh: 我掉出林地，孢子也留不住。
lines.en: I fall out of the woods and even my spores cannot stay.
